title: Remote key and control behavior
summary: Feedback on the remote key and control centers on limited remote functionality and sluggish or finicky locking and opening behavior, with most examples lacking clear sentiment labels.

negative.summary: The negative feedback explicitly complains that the car lacks remote-controlled cabin heater activation.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention self-relocking after unlocking, short remote range for door locking, no remote trunk operation, and slow remote response without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled examples are undetermined, so clear sentiment conclusions are limited.
The topic mixes several remote-related subjects, including heater control, door locking range and behavior, trunk operation, and response speed.
These samples are stratified and not representative estimates of all reviews on this topic.
